tdd_evidence.scenario_statement: The protocol document declares all four mandatory aspects; a Go test reads the doc and asserts each required section heading and the transport statement are present.
tdd_evidence.notes: Encoded in Go test that reads docs/protocolo-ipc-nucleo-sidecar.md at relative path and asserts sections 1-4 and socket transport statement are present.

tdd_evidence.notes: Test design verifies AC-1 cannot go green on a stub; failure mode preserved in test suite.

tdd_evidence.scenario_statement: go build ./... and go vet ./... exit clean on the sidecar module after the skeleton is added.
tdd_evidence.details: 05-validation.json command 4 confirms both exit with code 0.

tdd_evidence.scenario_statement: Encoding an envelope and decoding it back yields the identical message for every declared message type (round-trip over the closed type set).
tdd_evidence.notes: Test matrix over six declared message types (Saludo, Sobre, EventoEntrante, Confirmacion, OrdenRespaldoSqlstore, AcuseRespaldoSqlstore).

tdd_evidence.scenario_statement: Decoding rejects an envelope whose protocol version differs from ipc.VersionProtocolo, returning a typed version-mismatch error.
tdd_evidence.notes: Typed error for version mismatch tested in mensajes_test.go; malformed input rejection tested without panic.

tdd_evidence.scenario_statement: The encoded form of every message is a single-line, depth-1 JSON object terminated by a newline.
tdd_evidence.notes: Assertion in mensajes_test.go on field-order preservation and depth-1 structure; restriction documented in protocol doc section 2.

tdd_evidence.scenario_statement: The incoming-event message carries only already-translated internal identifiers; no JID-shaped or raw-transport field.
tdd_evidence.notes: Test in mensajes_test.go asserts encoded field set is exactly the declared closed set for EventoEntrante; no transport identifier leakage.

tdd_evidence.scenario_statement: The sqlstore backup order and acknowledgement encode exactly the A-2 contract fields.
tdd_evidence.notes: OrdenRespaldoSqlstore and AcuseRespaldoSqlstore types match A-2 contract field set (orden, destino, identificador_de_ronda; identificador_de_ronda, resultado, ruta_de_la_copia, bytes, motivo).

tdd_evidence.scenario_statement: The structured logger emits one JSON object per line with correct escaping of quotes and backslashes.
tdd_evidence.notes: JSON handler with closed field set (adr-0019); escaping round-trip test included.

tdd_evidence.scenario_statement: The waLog adapter satisfies the whatsmeow logger interface and routes Debugf below the configured threshold.
tdd_evidence.notes: AdaptadorWaLog type implements waLog.Logger; debug output suppression tested in registro_test.go; no message content leakage to log.

tdd_evidence.scenario_statement: Building a session with the non-persisting device store returns a client without opening any network connection.
tdd_evidence.notes: NuevaSesion built against store.NoopDevice; test passes with no WhatsApp number and no pairing. No net.Dial, net.Listen or Connect() call in main.go.

tdd_evidence.scenario_statement: Configuration loads the socket path and log level from the environment with documented defaults and rejects an empty socket path.
tdd_evidence.notes: Configuracion.Cargar validates socket path non-empty; environment defaults for unset variables; test includes rejection case.
